items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I think Thelonious Monk got his early attack from Duke.

ctx.x: Well maybe the Celtics will come back. They have a good coach now, we’ll see what happens. Those were the glory days.
So Monk, are you doing some playing yourself?
Yeah, I’m a saxophone and I tinkle with piano.
